question: Who was thrown into the fire and did not burn?
why: Ibrahim was thrown into a great fire, and Allah commanded it: 'be coolness and safety' (21:69).

question: Which prophet was swallowed by a great fish?
why: Yunus called from the darkness: 'la ilaha illa Anta' — and his prayer is one the Prophet ﷺ said is always answered (21:87; Tirmidhi 3505, sahih per Darussalam).

question: Which prophet interpreted the king's dream in Egypt?
why: Yusuf interpreted the dream of seven fat and seven lean cows and became treasurer of Egypt (12:43-55).

question: Whose staff turned into a serpent before Pharaoh?
why: Musa threw down his staff and it became a clear serpent; he drew out his hand and it shone white (26:32-33).

question: Which prophet built the ark?
why: Nuh was commanded: 'build the ship under Our eyes' (11:37).

question: Which prophet was given a kingdom no one will have after him?
why: Sulayman asked for 'a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me' (38:35).

question: Who was the first prophet?
why: Adam is the first man and the first prophet (his story opens 2:30-39).

question: Which prophet's people were destroyed by a screaming wind?
why: 'Ad were destroyed by a bitter wind of seven nights and eight days (69:6-8) — the people of the prophet Hud.

question: Who was the first martyr in Islam?
why: Sumayyah bint Khayyat was killed for her faith in Makkah and is reported in the seerah sources as the first martyr in Islam.

question: Whose plea became the name of a surah of the Qur'an?
why: Surah Al-Mujadilah — 'the woman who argues' — was revealed for Khawlah (58:1).

question: Which woman, a servant he inherited from his father, cared for the young Prophet Muhammad ﷺ after his mother's death?
why: Umm Ayman (Barakah) cared for him in his childhood, and he honoured her all her life (seerah sources: Ibn Hisham, Ibn Sa'd).

question: Who is the only woman named in the Qur'an?
why: Maryam bint Imran — Surah Maryam (19) is named for her.

question: Which wife of the Prophet ﷺ kept the master copy of the first Qur'an?
why: The leaves were gathered in the custody of Hafsa; the standardized copies descended from it (Bukhari 4987-4988).

question: Who carried supplies to the cave of Thawr in two belts?
why: Asma smuggled food to the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr — she is known as 'Dhat an-Nitaqayn,' the possessor of the two belts.

question: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ approach first when Allah commanded him to offer his wives the choice between the world and Allah?
why: He began with Aisha, and she chose Allah, His Messenger and the Hereafter (33:28-29; Bukhari 4785). All his wives made the same choice.

question: In which cave did the Prophet ﷺ receive the first revelation?
why: The cave of Hira on Jabal an-Nur — the first word was 'Iqra' (96:1).

question: Who accompanied the Prophet ﷺ on the Hijrah as 'the second of two'?
why: 'He said to his companion — the second of two — do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us' (9:40).

question: Which battle is named 'the day of the criterion' in the Qur'an?
why: 'The day the two hosts met' — Badr, called furqan (8:41).

question: What stopped the coalition at the Battle of the Trench?
why: Allah sent a wind and a storm that broke the siege (33:9).

question: Which treaty 'looked like defeat' but opened Arabia?
why: The Qur'an called Hudaybiyyah 'a clear conquest' (48:1).

question: Who was the first caliph after the Prophet ﷺ?
why: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq; the Prophet ﷺ had him lead the prayer in his final illness.

question: Which companion gave the adhan from the roof of the Kaaba after the conquest of Makkah?
why: The Prophet ﷺ called Bilal to give the adhan at the Kaaba when Makkah was opened (seerah sources: Ibn Hisham).

question: Which companion was the first ambassador of Islam — sent to Madinah?
why: Mus'ab was sent back with the Madinan believers before the Hijrah (seerah).

question: Whose freeing freed a hundred families?
why: The Prophet ﷺ married Juwayriyya, and the companions then freed the captives of Banu al-Mustaliq, who were now his in-laws.

question: Which companion pulled the rings of the Prophet's ﷺ helmet out of his cheek at Uhud with his teeth, losing his own front teeth?
why: Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah pulled the helmet rings out with his teeth and lost his front teeth doing so (seerah sources: Ibn Hisham).

question: What is the first revealed word of the Qur'an?
why: 'Read, in the name of your Lord' (96:1).

question: How many surahs are in the Qur'an?
why: 114 surahs.

question: Which surah is named after a metal?
why: Al-Hadid — 'the iron' (57).

question: Ayat al-Kursi is in which surah?
why: Al-Baqarah 2:255 — 'His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth.'

question: 'Bismillah' opens every surah except which one?
why: Surah At-Tawbah (9) opens without the basmalah.

question: Which angel carries revelation?
why: Ruh al-Amin, the Trustworthy Spirit (26:193-194).

question: What are Munkar and Nakir?
why: The two angels who ask: who is your Lord, what is your religion, who is this man? (Tirmidhi 1071, hasan per Darussalam).

question: What breaks the whisper (waswas)?
why: 'If an evil suggestion comes from Satan, seek refuge in Allah' (7:200).

question: Which sign comes last among the ten major signs?
why: The fire that drives mankind to the gathering place is the last of the ten signs listed in the hadith of Hudhayfah (Muslim 2901).

question: What is the barzakh?
options: A barrier behind which nothing returns
why: 'Behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected' (23:100).

question: What does 'Islam' literally mean?
why: Submission to Allah — from aslama.

question: How many pillars of Islam are there?
why: Shahada, prayer, zakat, fasting, Hajj.

question: In which month do Muslims fast?
why: 'The month of Ramadan in which the Qur'an was revealed' (2:185).

question: What is the direction of prayer called?
why: The qiblah — toward al-Masjid al-Haram.

question: Which phrase is the testimony of faith?
why: The shahada's first half — 'there is no deity but Allah.'
